tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rje btsun sgrol ma la brten pa'i mdos kyi cho ga g.yul bzlog gi yi ge gong sa rdo rje 'chang lnga pa chen pos mdzad pa'i mthong ba don grub bka' gdams sa lugs rnying lugs sogs dang mthun par gtong tshul la phyag len gyi bab phal cher sa lo chen po yab sras kyi bzhed srol dang mthun pa bzhugs so// na mo gu ru ār+ya tā re ya/ deng sang sgrol ma g.yul mdos su grags pa 'di ni/ slob dpon chen po 'phags mchog klu sgrub las rim gyis brgyud do/ /dpal ldan a ti sha la bka' babs pa bzhin bod yul du thog mar bka' gdams pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams la dar bas/ de dag gi phyag len ni jo lugs kyi sgrol ma'i bdag bskyed dang / mdun bskyed mdos chog sogs yig rnying gi dngos bstan tsam mdzad nas gnod pa'i phyogs su mdos skyel ba tsam las zor sogs gzhan gyi rgyas 'gebs gtan nas med 'dra zhing / yang jo lugs 'di sa lugs kyi phyag len ltar na/ bcas bsham phal cher yig rnying bzhin dang / sngon 'gro gtor ma 'khyil sngags dang / swa bhā was bsangs sbyangs/ 'bru gsum gyis byin rlabs/ oṃ ka pā la sa pā ri wā ra a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ sogs kyis mgron bkug de la gtor ma bsngo ba/ mchod pa 'phrin 'chol rnams sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i 'jig rten pa'i gtor bsngo bzhin byas la/ gtor ma phyir dor ba dang khro sngags brjod/ mchod pa byin brlabs sgrub thabs brgya rtsa bzhin/ skyabs sems yan lag bdun pa sogs la sa bon dang lha'i skur bsgyur ba ma gtogs spyi 'gre ltar dang / tshad med bzhi/ ye shes tshogs gsog dngos gzhi'i sgrol ma'i bdag bskyed yan lag bzhi rdzogs bzlas pa bcas ni sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rigs 'gre sbyar te sgrol ljang las shes nus/ mdun bskyed a mṛ tas bsangs ba nas bzung / mi tshe dge zhing dngos grub ma lus stsol/ /zhes pa'i bar gong sa lnga pa'i mdos chog bzhin la/

sman raka gtor gsum dang tshogs med/ sgrol ma'i gtor 'bul yan la dril gsil gdong dang mchod rol sogs skabs su gang bab tsam las/ rnga rol dbyangs sogs spros pa med/ gur zhal sogs chos skyong la gtor ma 'bul na yi dam gyi gtor bsngo sngon du 'gro ba can sa lo yab sras kyi gtor bsngo chen mo sogs nas 'byung ba de kha sor bzhag bstod pa rdzogs pa'i bar dang / bskang ba byed par spro na bskang rdzas byin rlabs nas bzung rdor glu bkra shis smon lam rdzogs pa'i bar byas la/ phyogs skyong gzhi bdag sde brgyad rnams la gtor ma bsngo ba'i phyogs skyong dang sde brgyad kyi gtor ma cha gsum bzhin dang / gzhi bdag la gtor ma brgya rtsa nas byung ba'i gtor bsngo chen mo ltar btang la/ na mo dkon mchog gsum sogs dkyus bzhin te gang ltar mdos gong bzhin skyel ba las zor gyi spros pa med/ 'on kyang zor rgyas pa la dga' na khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba sogs kyis mdzad pa'i gdugs dkar mdos chen gyi zor de 'dir sbyar bas sa lugs dang bu lugs kyi phyag len dri med du 'gre'o/ /deng sang sa lugs la sgrol ma g.yul bzlog gi phyag len dar so che ba ni/ kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa chen po kun dga' rnam rgyal gyi ring lugs 'dzin pa rnams yin pas de ga'i phyag len ltar la dbyangs rol sogs cho ga'i khrid rnams sa lo yab sras kyi bka' srol ltar bkod na/ bsham ni gong sa lnga pa chen po'i gsung rgyun zin bris de nang bzhin la gtor bsngo dang bskang ba byed pa spro na/ dam rdzas bcu/ bdun/ lnga/ gsum/ gcig gang rung dang / bkram bskang / bsdus bskang gang rung / thun gtor/ phud chang / chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer mchod rnams kyang bshams la/ cho ga'i rim pa sngon 'gro gtor ma chu chang gis sbyangs/ spos kyis bdag la lag g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba bigha sogs kyis bsngo/

hūm̐ ngo / zhes sbyar la nyon cig nas/ myur du deng gi bar la gang zhig 'byung po'i dbyangs rol chems brdung bcas grub pa dang / rol mo 'phar chen gcig blangs la/ phur pa'i byin dbab rgyas pa'i bsdus pa na mo bla ma bde gshegs nas/ byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi zhes pa'i bar gur drag bzhin nyer gcig na mo sems bskyed 'gro ba kun don du nas/ 'gro drug sgrol bar dam bca' 'o'i bar yang gur drag bzhin lan gsum/ rang skad cig gis rta mchog rol pa'i skur gyur zhes dang / drag dung drag rol gyi rjes su gsum brdeg gur drag la gsum brdeg med kyang 'di dmigs bsal yin/ 'then rkang gnyis/ dgu brdeg 'then rkang gnyis/ che gcig rnams byas la/ hūm̐ ngo zhes sbyar nas nga ni sogs la myur mgyogs sde brgyad ma'i dbyangs bcug ste/ lnga wa yi ye me zhes pa rnams la dzar rgyag dang / dbyangs rdzogs nas rol mo bdud rgyal bskul bzhin/ yang khro chung sogs la'ang dbyangs de kha bcug nas/ mtshams ma las yongs su zhes pa rnams la dzar rgyag dang / rol mo gong bzhin gyis mthar chems brdung sgang dung gsum brdeg len can byas nas rnga rol bzhag mchod gtor la rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod 'thor tshul dang / oṃ swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las nas/ lha mos gang ba/ zhes pa'i rjes su sman raka gtor gsum zhes sogs nas/ gyur zhes pa'i bar brjod la sman raka gtor gsum gyi sngags dbyangs phyag rgya gur drag bzhin/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags phyag rgya gdangs med lan gsum/ rten bskyed nas bzung / rgyud bskul nas zhes pa'i rjes su/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang bsdu rgya se gol bcom dung bcom rol gsum brdeg gi rjes su gzhi bdag chung ba bzhi/ bcu brdeg gcig rnams byas la/ hūm̐ nga'o nga zhes sbyar la/ chos sku nas ngang can ma zhes pa'i bar dang / tshur gshegs nas taṃ yig las zhes pa'i bar sh+lau ka gnyis la pu tra'i spyan 'dren gyi dbyangs rol tshar gnyis/

yid bzhin nas 'dir gshegs su gsol gyi rjes su gsum brdeg len can bsdus pa/ chems brdung / gsum brdeg len can/ rgyas pa rol skor 'beb bcas byas la ji snyed su dag nas/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad bdag gis bstod par phyag 'tshal/ me tog dam pa sogs kyi/ rgyal ba de dag la yang mchod par bgyi/ zhes pa la dril gsil mchod rol gyi 'og blangs te/ na bza' dam pa nas/ phyag 'tshal mchod par bgyis bar rol mo'i bar la brjod la/ tsog pu thar sbyar gyis 'dod chags zhe sdang sogs nas/ phyir bsngo'i bar brjod/ phyag gcig btsal nas stan la 'khod/ dril gsil gdangs dang bcas pas/ hūm̐ bsod nams/ zhes sogs kyi mthar/ rdor dril pad skor dang bcas pas pad+ma'i phyag rgya/ e ma ho/ dus gsum sogs la'ang gdangs dang / sh+lau ka re'i mtshams su dril gsil/ rdo rje phyag 'tshal ba'i stangs ka sngags la pad kor gong bzhin la thal sbyar phyag 'tshal ba'i stangs ka khrus dngos su byed na/ las kyi rdo rjes sngar nas gzhan du bsgrubs zin pa'i khrus bum dang khrus long sogs thogs la/ dril gsil gdangs bcas dkyus 'gre/ sku phyis/ dkyus 'gre/ na bza' dang rgyan la gos zung 'bul ba'i stangs ka gdangs dkyus 'gre/ mchod yon zhabs bsil gdangs 'bul ba'i gdangs kyang hūm̐ yod pa ma gtogs kun rig gi gdangs sogs dkyus 'gre mchod sngags la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sbyar kyang 'gal ba med/ maṇ+ḍal so bdun ma gdangs bcas/ gang gi mchod rdzas ma dang / deng nas byang chub ma la dbyangs yod med gang rung bzhes nas byin gyis brlabs tu gsol bar/ yang gong bzhin dril bu sh+lau ka re'i mtshams su gsil zhing / rdo rje phyag 'tshal ba'i stangs ka dang me tog gi dbul bar bgyi zhes pa'i rjes su/ mchod rol byas la sngags brjod pa dang bstun/ rdor dril pad kor me tog gi phyag rgya/ de bzhin du spos nas bzung rol mo'i bar la rigs 'gre sbyar la so so'i phyag rgya/

rol mo'i mchod rol gyi rjes su nyis brdeg len can byas la/ hūm̐ ngo zhes sbyar te/ srid par gtogs pa sh+lau ka gcig la rak+ta dmar chen dbyangs/ nyis brdeg len can chems brdung / de phyin chad la dbyangs mi byed na/ gcig gnyis gsum byas la bzhag dbyangs byed na nyis brdeg len can dbyangs sogs gong bzhin/ 'dod yon drug la rigs 'gre/ mi byed na phyi ma rnams la dbul bar bgyi la/ gsum brdeg len can bsdus pa chems brdung / ma hā mu dra hūm̐ gi chems brdung gi rjes su/ gsum brdeg len can rgyas par byas la/ hūm̐ ngo zhes sbyar nas/ gsang mchod sh+lau ka lnga la/ dur khrod smug nag ma'i dbyangs dzar ring thung / gsum brdeg len can rnams byas pa'i sh+lau ka rjes ma'i gsum brdeg len can gyi rjes su chems brdung gsum brdeg len can rgyas pa/ sgrol ma'i gtor ma/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li sogs kyis bsangs/ rang gi thugs ka nas raṃ dmar po 'phros pas/ zhes sogs phur pa bzhin/ gu h+ye sid+dhi sa ma ya hūm̐ gi bar phyag rgya se gol bcas lan gsum sogs kyi byin gyis brlabs la rnga brdung zhing / gur drag bla med mchod pa'i dbyangs dang bcas/ hūm̐ ngo tshar nas mnyes gyur cig gi bar dbyangs yug gcig gi rjes su/ gsum brdeg len can rgyas par chems brdung gi tshe/ gtor sngags lan bdun sogs ci rigs bzla/ gur drag bzhin bcom rol 'phar ma nyis brdeg len can du blangs la/ bstod pa sh+lau ka gsum rak+ta dmar chen ma'i dbyangs rol tshar gsum/ rol mo rnams nyis brdeg len can yin/ phyag 'tshal nyer gcig la'ang rnga brdung mdzad srol yod pas/ phyag 'tshal sgrol ma myur ma dpal mo nas/ 'joms pa tu re rab mchog nyid ma'i bar rnga brdung 'dur ma bcas bstod pa tshar gnyis kyi rjes ma'i rjes su/ 'joms pa tu re rab mchog nyid ces bcad la/ ma zhes pa dang rol mo hod kyis blangs nas/ chems brdung bsangs bzhin byas la gcig gnyis gsum zer ba dang rnga rol bzhag

rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs khar phog pas de rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bur 'phros te 'khor 'das snod bcud thams cad kyi byin rlabs nus mthu ma lus par bsdus nas bum pa'i nang du thim par gyur zhes dang / slob dpon gyi gzungs thag bzung nas yi ge bcu pa 'ur 'don phreng 'khor/ ār+ya ta re zhes yi ge bzhi pa'ang 'ur 'don phreng 'khor/ yang rnga brdung dang bcas pas phyag 'tshal nyer gcig tshar gsum/ mjug gi rol mo 'jog tshul sogs dang / sngags le tshan gong bzhin/ yang rnga brdung gi phyag 'tshal nyer gcig tshar bdun/ rol mo 'jog tshul/ sngags gong bzhin/ 'on kyang rjes ma gnyis la rang gi snying ga sogs dmigs pa gsal 'debs ma brjod kyang chog pas/ sngags la btsan 'jus bya/ yi ge bzhi pa rdzogs pa dang / gzungs thag bsdus la bshags pa bya ba ni/ thal mo sbyar te/ gnas brtan phyag mchod kyi gdangs dang bcas/ rje btsun 'phags ma nas byang bar shog bar/ badz+ra sa ma sogs phreng 'khor/ yig brgya nyer gcig rnams 'ur 'don/ yang thal mo sbyar te/ thugs dam gnad bskul la/ thos rgyal ma'i gdangs sam/ spro na sh+lau ka lnga la thos rgyal ma'i dbyangs/ de phyin la gdangs byas la/ mtha' ru phyin par shog bar/ de nas sgrub pa po yon bdag dang bcas par dbang bskur gyi dmigs pa gsal btab ste/ tshogs pa mang du yod na mchod dpon gyi gral gsham nas/ bum pa tshogs pa rnams kyi dbu gtsug tu 'jog tshul byas la/ dbang bskur ba'i tshigs bcad la lam 'bras phyag mchod kyi gdangs dang sngags rnams 'dur ma/ a bhi ṣiñca hrīḥrjes su slob dpon nas bzung tshogs pa rnams dang yon bdag yod na bum chu bskyed/ rang gcig pu'am yon bdag kha shas las med na/ dpral mgrin snying gar re re dang / sh+lau ka rjes mar gnas gsum du bum pa dus gcig tu reg la 'thung zhing khrus bya/

mdos kyi mchod gtor rnams la dmigs/ swā bhā was sbyangs pa nas bzung dang nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya'i bar gong bzhin/ mdun bskyed a mṛ tas bsangs ba nas bzung / sa mā dzaḥbar/ ma lus sems can nas bzung / sku khrus gsol gyi bar sngags dang phyag rgya med pa ma gtogs gdangs dang dril gsil kun rig bzhin/ sa gzhi spos byugs la yang gdangs de kha'i mthar me tog gtor/ chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod rol mo la/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho ma'i gdangs dang pad kor mchod pa so so'i phyag rgya/ se gol/ shap+ta la rol chen/ lha dang lha min sogs sh+lau ka gcig dang / phyag 'tshal sgrol ma myur ma dpal mo nas/ byung ma bar shur ma/ rdo rje thugs ka dang / dril bu rgyun chags byas la bzhag de phyin gyi rab 'byams rgya mtsho ma'ang gdung shugs gang rung byas la mthar rol chen/ lha dang lha min sh+lau ka gcig dang / phyag 'tshal ston ka'i zla ba kun tu nas/ rab tu phye ba'i 'od rab 'bar ma/ /zhes pa'i bar la'ang dril gsil gong bzhin de bzhin du/ phyag 'tshal nyer gcig ma rdzogs pa'i bar la/ mchod yon nas rol mo'i bar gyi rab 'byams rgya mtsho tshar re dang / lha dang lha min sogs sngon 'gro'i phyag 'tshal nyer gcig gi 'phros sh+lau ka re spel nas byed pa'o/ /'joms pa tu re rab mchog nyid ma zhes dril gsil bzhag pa dang gtor ma byin brlabs sngon du 'grub pa'i thog bla gtor bsngos/ de nas dkon mchog de nas sgrol ma rnams la bsngos la/ rang re'i gtor bsngo chen mo kyai rdor gyi gtor bsngo'i byin rlabs nas bzung bshags pa rdzogs pa'i bar bya/ de dang chabs cig sgrol mdos kyi gras la bshams pa'i srung ma'i gtor ma'ang bsngo ba'i dmigs par byed/ bskang gso mi byed na de'i rjes su zhwa gyon nas dril gsil dang bcas gur lcam dral zhal rnams kyi sngags thung sngon 'gro'i bstod pa sangs rgyas bstan srung ma mgon po nas phur srung gi bar byas la bzhag

bskang ba byed na bskang rdzas byin rlabs nas bzung / rdor glu bkra shis smon lam gyi bar byas la/ phyogs skyong gi gtor ma a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ a kā ro dang rdo rje bsdams pa 'debs tshul se gol gyis byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi snying ga nas/ zhes sogs nas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang / yang dag don du la dbyangs bcug pa'i 'og bzhin rol mo blang / phyogs skyong spyan 'dren sh+lau ka gnyis la yang dag don du'i dbyangs 'khor gcig rol mo chems brdung gi sbug la spyan 'dren dang mchod sngags brjod nas gsum brdeg len can rgyas par/ dbang po rdo rje 'chang ba'i lha/ /zhes sogs nas/ dam tshig shes pa'i tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /zhes pa'i bar la phur sgrub phyi rol gtor ma'i/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bsnams la zhes pa'i gdangs dang rol mo byas la bzhag gtor ma lan gsum bsngos/ yang rnga brdung la shar phyogs rdo rje can gyi sogs 'dur shur gang rung gi mthar tshig rol byas la bzhag gzhi bdag gtor ma phyogs skyong ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ saṃ bha ra'i sngags mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya se gol dang bcas pa lan gyis bsngos la/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod/ rdo rje thugs ka dang dril bu rgyun chags su dkrol la/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa 'di nyid ni rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi gtso byas zhes sogs nas/ gtor ma bsngos pas 'khon 'gras med par mdzod ces pa'i bar brjod/ sde brgyad kyi gtor ma phyogs skyong ltar byin gyis brlabs/ rnga brdung brgya bzhi lugs/ chos kyi sbyin pa'i mthar tshig rol byas la bzhag thal mo sbyar te/ na mo dkon mchog gsum gyi zhes sogs nas/ sbyor bar byed pa rnams kyi bar gyur cig ces brjod la/ slob dpon gyi dril bu gsil/ rdo rje gsol/

gzhan rnams kyis drag rol drag dung bya/ bgegs gtor phyogs skyong ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ bden bdar nas bzung / gdon khyod rang gi gnas song bar brgya bzhi bzhin/ bden bdar la khyad par du yang / rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma'i lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / zhes dang / bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i sogs rnga brdung / rol mo/ na mo dkon mchog nas/ bden pa'i byin brlabs kyi zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin la/ bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu'i gnod sems dang / /gdug rtsub thams cad zhi bar gyur cig ces dang / gong bzhin rdor dril gsor dkrol drag rol drag dung byas la bgegs gtor phyir dor/ rigs drug gtor ma byin brlabs gong bzhin bsngo tshul brgya rtsa bzhin la/ ting shags kyi tshab dril bu rgyun chags/ lan chags la'ang byin brlabs gong bzhin dang / bsngo ba brgya rtsa dang dril bu rgyun chags kyi mthar rdor dril gsol dkrol drag rol drag dung / tshogs thog mtha' bar gsum gur drag sor bzhag la/ dregs pa'i dgra bgegs tshar gcod pa'i/ /khro rgyal rta mgrin sku la bstod/ /ces dang / che mchog pad+ma rta mgrin rgyal/ /phyag g.yas pad+ma'i dbyug tho 'phyar/ /g.yon pas thugs kar sdig mdzub mdzad/ /gnod byed pho mo rdul du bzlog /ces dang / oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro dha zhes sogs dang / phur pa dang / ral gris liṅga sgrol ba gur drag bzhin/ phyi nang gsang ba ma phur pa bzhin/ mjug tu chems brdung gsum brdeg len can byas la bzhag tshogs la rol ba/ ho zhal zas tshogs kyi sogs dang lhag ma gur drag bzhin/ rang skad cig gis rta mchog rol pa'i skur gyur/ zhes dang drag rol bcom la gsum brdeg 'then rkang gnyis dgu brdung 'then rkang gnyis che gcig hūm̐ zhes sbyar la/ dam can chos skyong sh+lau ka gsum la chos nyid ma'i bzlog dbyangs rol mo tshar gsum/

yid 'ong mchod pa nas 'dur shur gang rung / khyed rnams kun la 'bul lags kyi la tshig rol dgu brdung / de nas rnga phyir brdung du byas la sngags pa'i sogs/ bdag cag longs spyod 'phel bar mdzod la tshig rol dgu brdung / rkyen ngan sogs/ mi tshe dge zhing dngos grub stsol la tshig rol dgu brdung gi mthar chems brdung drag dung gi mthar gsum brdeg len can/ gal te grangs gsog byed na rigs drug gtor ma rdzogs nas tshogs 'khor mi byed par mchod gtor yas rnams gsos te sbyangs gdugs byin brlabs gong bzhin byas la/ mdun bskyed bskyed chog nas/ sa gzhi spos byugs ma'i bar der/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho la phyag 'tshal nyer gcig sbyar ba nas bzung / dngos grub ma lus stsol gyi bar tshar gsum sogs 'don pa yin kyang / phyag len phal cher la tshar gcig po de las mi mdzad/ grangs gsog byas pa yin na/ dngos grub ma lus stsol gyi rjes su tshogs 'khor sogs byed/ zhag kha shas sgrub na/ nyin dang po rnams la/ dngos grub ma lus stsol gyi bzlog rol chems brdung drag dung gsum brdeg len can bcas grub pa dang / gtor bsngo yang thun gtor bshams pa'i bskang gso dang 'brel pa'i spyi bstabs srid zhi dpal 'byor ma sogs byas la/ me tog dang bcas thal mo sbyar te/ oṃ grub par nas/ thob par shog bar gnas brtan phyag mchod kyi gdangs bcas tshar gsum/ mdun bskyed la dmigs/ ār+ya ta re sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ zhes sogs chu gnyis nyer mchod rol chen/ lha dang lha min sogs bstod pa sh+lau ka gcig dril gsil gdangs bcas/ yig brgya/ bzod gsol/ brtan bzhugs/ gshegs gsol rnams gtor bsngo'i mjug bzhin sogs dkyus 'gre/ bdag gi dus gsum sogs smon lam tshar gsum gdangs med/ mtshungs med bla ma nas/ don gyi bkra shis shog bar gtor bsngo chen mo bzhin la/ ho dus gsum sogs/

sgrol ma'i bkra shis tshig rkang drug gi mthar dril gsil/ sngon tshe rdo rje 'chang gi'am/ 'jigs rung dus mtha'i sogs skabs bstun gyi bkra shis bya'o/ /mdos gtong ba'i nyin/ dngos grub ma lus stsol gyi bzlog rol chems brdung drag dung gsum brdeg len can rdzogs nas/ mdos kyi mtha'i gtor ma rnams mdos nang du bsgril/ mdos sgo phyogs la zhal bsgyur/ de'i mdun la zor rdzas rnams bsgrigs la dkar lam 'then/ slob dpon zhwa nag gos nag rdor dril 'dzin pa'i chas su bzhugs/ dpon slob rnams langs nas rnga rol thogs te bcom rol dam tshig chen po'i 'chams dbyangs kyi 'og bzhin la rkang gling g.yab dar de phyin rkang gling g.yab dar byed pa'ang gtor bzlog spyi 'gre bzhin/ kyai ya' ya' ya' ya/ bskyed yod do zhes sogs dam tshig chen mo'i 'chams dbyangs bcug la/ yul 'khor srung gi sde tshan gyi da bsgyur tshal la 'then rkang gsum dang dgu brdung bzlog rol bzhin/ de nas 'dur shur gang rung dang / lho nub byang rnams kyi sde tshan re rdzogs pa dang dgu brdung bzlog rol bzhin rdzogs pa dang / gsum brdung ji ltar rigs pas bde yangs sogs phyi rol gang 'os su thon nas der zlog zor sogs bsgrigs la/ dzam len sngon 'gro'i bzhi 'gros ci rigs grub pa dang gsum brdeg len can/ hūm̐ srid pa'i mdos bdag sh+lau ka gcig la mon bu pu tra'i dbyangs rol tsho gnyis/ srid pa'i mdos chen nas 'dur shur gang rung la lho nub mtshams kyi sde tshan rdzogs mtshams dang / 'og gi sde tshan rdzogs mtshams tshig rol dgu brdung gi ngang nas mdos btegs la gsum brdung ji ltar rigs pas 'phen par slebs pa dang / bzhi 'gres ci rigs kyi mthar rol mo dgu brdung du bsgyur la/ kyai da ni mdos la kha bsgyur 'tshal/ /zhes sogs 'dur shur gang rung la/ phyogs bzhi'i bskul gyi mtha'i tshe 'dir 'gugs so snyan ma bsra/

zhes pa thams cad la tshig rol dgu brdung rjes mar chems brdung gsum brdeg len can byas la rnga rol bzhag gser skyems byin brlabs ni/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li sogs kyis bsangs/ rang gi thugs ka nas raṃ zhes sogs phur pa bzhin la/ gser skyems dpal ldan rtsa brgyud sogs mgon po drug cu bzhin dang / yi dam rgyud sde bzhi'i lha'i rjes su/ khyad par thabs mkhas thugs rje can/ /rje btsun sgrol ma'i lha tshogs rnams/ /zhes pa tsam bsgyur/ de nas slob dpon gyi phod brjes sogs bde chas byas la khrag zor thogs/ rol mo dgu brdung du bsgyur nas mdos gang la 'phen pa'i phyogs su kha bltas te/ bh+yo shar lho zhes sogs 'dur shur gang rung la/ khrag gi de ni zor 'phangs pas/ /zhes pa dang khrag zor 'phangs/ de bzhin du yungs zor/ 'tshe zor/ gtor zor rnams kyang tshig dang bstun nas 'phang la/ do nub zor lam sgo phye shig ces pa'i tshig rol dgu brdung dang bstun ci yang ma thog par 'chams tshul byed/ bh+yo rnal 'byor gling bzhi'i sogs 'dur shur gang rung gi rjes su tshig rol dgu brdung / zor lam phyogs bzhi bstan skabs/ bh+yo zor lam lho yi phyogs su bstan/ /zhes sogs la/ gshin rje pho ni zhes sogs dang / nub la chu lha pho ni zhes sogs dang / byang la gnod sbyin pho ni zhes sogs tshig bsgyur la/ zor bskul ni/ rtsa brgyud dpal ldan bla ma yis/ /do nub zor gyi las mdzod cig /yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyis/ /do nub zor gyi las mdzod cig /dam can bstan srung rgya mtsho yis/ /do nub zor gyi las mdzod cig /bdag gi mdos zor gnyen po 'di/ /rig 'dzin bla mas byin gyis brlabs/ /zhes sogs nas/ bh+yo bh+yo gnod pa'i bgegs la bh+yo/ /zhes pa'i bar phur bzlog bzhin brjod la me phung chen po'i dbus su mdos dgra phyogs su rtse bstan la 'phen tshul byed do/

/thun brab dang gu gul gyi dud pa gsungs pa ni phyag len mi 'dra ba'i khyad par te/ zor lam bstan pa yan chad bde yangs lta bur byas pa yin na de dag dgos kyang / 'dir zor 'phen par gzhung lhag ma rnams yongs rdzogs btang bas gu gul dang thun brab mi dgos/ bstan skyong ni nang ngam steng du sgrub gtor 'bul rgyu yod tshe sa lo'i phyag len la de dang chabs cig mdzad/ bsrung 'khor ni rgyun gyi gtor bzlog la byed pa bzhin slob dpon kho nas gsal 'debs byas kyang chog mod/ 'on kyang gong dkar ba rnams kyi phyag len la mdos 'phangs grub pa dang slob dpon zhal rnga rol la gzigs/ rnga rol bzhag nas dpon slob tshang mas/ steng yang rdo rje'i bla re la nas/ bhañja ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa kyi bar phur pa bzhin phyag rgya bcas mdzad/ yar log ste sgo drung du gtor gzhong kha sbub la de'i mthar dpon slob rnams lag pa g.yon steng du bton te bsnol bas srin mdzub sbrel la/ oṃ laṃ hūm̐ laṃ dgra bgegs sha trun stāṃ bha ya nan/ zhes tshar gcig dang / hūm̐ rta yi brtul zhugs chen po ni/ /bdag nyid chen po'i skur bsgom te/ /zhing bcu bsgral ba'i phung po la/ /gtum chen rngams pa'i sgra sgrogs shing / /dbang chen rta skad tse re re/ /khro bo'i shugs sgra 'u ru ru/ /dpal gyi nga ro di ri ri/ /rol pa'i rta bro chems se chem/ /gsang ba'i bshug glu kyu ru ru/ /bskal pa'i glog dmar chems se chem/ /rdo rje thog 'bebs lams se lam/ /hūm̐ gis dbang bsgyur khams gsum g.yo/ /phaṭa kyi sprul pas 'jig rten khyab/ /raṃ gyis me 'bar thams cad sreg /gcan gzan mu kha sprin ltar gtibs/ /kang ka 'dab chags skar ltar 'khrugs/ /sngon gyi thugs dam bskang ba'i phyir/ /kun tu bzang po'i mkha' dbyings su/ /khams gsum yongs sgrol mdzad pa'i phyir/ /dpal gyi rta bro 'di ltar brdungs/ /za byed chen po'i dkyil 'khor du/

/dug lnga 'dus pa'i phung po la/ /gcan gzan chen po bro brdungs pas/ /bdag tu lta ba'i zhe sdang bcom/ /khrag 'thung chen po'i dkyil 'khor du/ /rak+ta'i rgya mtsho bskyil ba la/ /ma tshogs ḍā ka'i bro brdung pas/ kun tu zhen pa'i 'dod chags bcom/ /rngam chen 'khrugs pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /gti mug sha chen spungs pa la/ sder chags 'dus pa'i bro brdung pas/ /rmongs pa'i gti mug ngo bo bcom/ /gtum chen khros pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /dpa' bo yan lag rdzogs pa la/ /gshog pa rdo rje'i bro brdung pas/ /kun tu rmongs pa'i phrag dog bcom/ /'jigs byed chen po'i dkyil 'khor du/ /dbus kyi khri rkang zlum po la/ /rdo rje mchu yis bro brdung pas/ /bdag tu 'dzin pa'i nga rgyal bcom/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor du/ dug gsum 'joms pa'i las byas pas/ /sngon gyi dam tshig gnyen po bskangs/ /ma tshogs ḍā ka'i༞ /tan gan sprul pa'i las byas pas/ /rnal 'byor bskang ba'i cho ga rdzogs/ /dbang chen gar gyi༞ /bdud bzhi 'joms pa'i las byas pas/ khams gsum bsgral ba'i cho ga rdzogs/ /phyag brnyan chen po'i dkyil 'khor du/ /bka' 'das bsgral ba'i las byas pas/ /ru tra mnan pa'i cho ga rdzogs/ /oṃ badz+ra kro dha sid+dhi hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya gri wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa ste de yang / hūm̐ rta yi rtul bzhugs nas/ mdzad pa'i phyir bar 'dur ma/ de nas gdangs dang bcas g.yas bskor du phyin te/ dpal gyi rta bro nas/ mnan pa'i cho ga rdzogs bar sngags la g.yon bskor/ gong dkar ba rnams sgrol ma'i yi ge bcu pa bzla gsung yang rta mgrin gyi 'di ga 'thad dam snyam/ bskang gtor yod na sgrub khang ngam khang steng du 'bul ba dang chabs cig bstan skyong srid zhi dpal 'byor ma sogs bya/ mjug chog ni gong bzhin no/ /zhes sgrol ma g.yul bzlog gi yig cha kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i dbang po gong sa rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sde'i zhal snga nas kyis gsung rab bzhin la dbyangs rol chog bsgrigs sogs cho ga'i yan lag phra mor gyur pa rnams sa lo tsā ba chen po yab sras kyi phyag len gyi babs dang bstun legs par sbyar ba 'di ni/

sde dge phur pa bla ma sangs rgyas bzang po dang / sde dge dbu byed kun dga' bsod nams sogs kyis bskul ba bzhin sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni bsod 'od do// //maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 12 kun dga' blo gros/ sgrol ma g.yul bzlog gi yi ge sa lo yab sras kyi bzhed srol dang mthun pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 13
